17:87.text: as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favor upon you has ever been great.

17:88.text: Say, "If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants."

17:89.text: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur’ān from every
example, but most of the people refused except disbelief.

17:90.text: And they say, "We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring

17:91.text: you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force

17:92.text: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring Allāh and the angels before

17:93.text: Or you have a house of ornament
or you ascend into the sky. And
, we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read." Say, "Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?"

17:94.text: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, "Has Allāh sent a human messenger?"

17:95.text: Say, "If there were upon the earth angels walking securely,
We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel

17:96.text: Say, "Sufficient is Allāh as Witness between me and you. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Aware and Seeing."
